Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n\nInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n\n## Pull requests as a triage surface\n\n**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n\nWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n\n- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n\nGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n\n## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n\nCreate a GitHub issue.\n\n## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n\nRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n\n## Wayfinding operations\n\nUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n\n- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.\n- **Blocking**: GitHub's **native issue dependencies**, the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric **database id** (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, _not_ the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies aren't available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.\n- **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.\n- **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`, the session's first write.\n- **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body \"<answer>\"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.\n# Data Bites and Reports carry chart images, referenced from the Markdown body\n\n**Status:** accepted (reverses the original spec's \"uploads for Data Bites\" exclusion, #1; spec #11)\n\nThe office's content is mostly numbers, and it already makes charts of them\nin Excel, R, and Tableau. The original spec kept Data Bites Markdown-only and\ngave Reports one attached PDF, so a chart had nowhere to go except an image\nlink to some other host. That puts it outside the draft/publish gate, and it\nbreaks when the other host changes.\n\nWe decided: **both** Data Bites and Reports can carry chart images, uploaded on\nthe item's edit page and placed in its Markdown body as `image:<name>`.\nData Bites were included on purpose, not only Reports. A Data Bite such as\n\"Fall enrollment snapshot\" is exactly where a chart is wanted.\n\n**Uploaded files, not generated charts.** The CMS stores and shows a chart\nsomeone made elsewhere; it does not draw one from data. That keeps the stack\nunchanged (no charting or image library, `pyproject.toml` is fixed), works\nwith whatever tool the office already uses, and leaves no JavaScript on the\npublic site. Charts drawn from a data block in the Markdown were considered\nand deferred as a possible stretch. Embeds (Tableau Public, Power BI) were\nrejected, because they need `<iframe>` through the sanitizer.\n\n**Raster only: PNG, JPEG, WebP. No SVG.** An SVG is a document that can carry\n`<script>` and event handlers, and serving an uploaded one from the site's own\norigin would reopen the hole the Markdown sanitizer closes. Content is checked\nby signature, the way T05 checks a PDF, because there is no decoding library.\n\n**`image:<name>`, resolved at render time.** The body never holds a path. The\nMarkdown pipeline turns `image:<name>` into the URL for the page being rendered\n(admin preview, public page, or export), so one stored body works at every\ndepth and the published HTML stays relative. An unknown name renders nothing.\n\n**An image belongs to its item.** It is public only while that item is\npublished, and it follows that item's permissions (ADR-003 unchanged): any\nAnalyst may manage a Data Bite's images or a draft Report's, and only the\nDirector a published Report's. Deleting the item deletes its images.\n\nOne consequence, accepted: an image is public for as long as its item is\npublished, whether or not the body places it. An image uploaded to a\npublished Data Bite is served, and exported by `cms publish`, at once, even\nbefore the body references it. A chart that isn't ready to be seen goes on a\ndraft, not on a published item.","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"34f0625c-1c03-4961-b76f-c29da1966976","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e3762848-f058-4781-8416-224a321c2f16","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"25446a26-8f4d-43e1-aea2-d26128f8a27e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"53fa6da9-8f7a-4671-b98f-abfb45172e2f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ad6TQCAeWu762Ar4584hdN","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Markdown to safe HTML: the one pipeline every rendering of user-written\nMarkdown goes through: the public site, its export, and the Site preview.\n\nmarkdown-it-py renders (raw HTML in the Markdown is let through to it), then\nnh3 sanitizes, dropping <script>, event-handler attributes, javascript: URLs,\nand anything else not on its allowlist. The stored body stays raw; only this\nfunction's output is ever marked safe.\n\nTwo additions to nh3's allowlist, both for Markdown tables:\n  - `style` on a table cell, but only as exactly `text-align:left|right|center`,\n    so a column's alignment (`|---:|`) survives and nothing else does.\n  - the class TABLE_SCROLL on a <div>: each Markdown table is wrapped in one, so\n    a wide table can scroll sideways without restyling the <table> itself.\n\nAnd one addition to Markdown, for chart images (ADR-004): an image whose URL\nis `image:<name>` gets its URL from the `image_src` the caller passes, which\nknows the item's images and where the page being rendered finds them. A name\nit doesn't know, or no `image_src`, renders nothing. Any other image URL is\nleft to the sanitizer.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nTABLE_SCROLL = \"content-table-scroll\"\nIMAGE_REFERENCE = \"image:\"\n# A chart image's name -> its URL from the page being rendered; None if the\n# item has no image of that name.\nImageSrc = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n_MARKDOWN = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\")\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_open\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    f'<div class=\"{TABLE_SCROLL}\">\\n' + self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env)))\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_close\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env) + \"</div>\\n\"))\n\n\ndef _chart_image_name(token) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The name in an `image:<name>` image token; None for any other image.\"\"\"\n    src = token.attrGet(\"src\")\n    return src.removeprefix(IMAGE_REFERENCE) if str(src).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE) else None\n\n\ndef _render_image(self, tokens, idx, options, env):\n    name = _chart_image_name(tokens[idx])\n    if name is not None:\n        url = env[\"image_src\"](name) if env.get(\"image_src\") else None\n        if url is None:\n            return \"\"\n        tokens[idx].attrSet(\"src\", url)\n    return self.image(tokens, idx, options, env)\n\n\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"image\", _render_image)\n\n_TABLE_CELLS = (\"th\", \"td\")\n_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = {**nh3.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                       **{cell: nh3.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES.get(cell, set()) | {\"style\"}\n                          for cell in _TABLE_CELLS}}\n_TEXT_ALIGN = re.compile(r\"\\s*text-align\\s*:\\s*(left|right|center)\\s*\", re.I)\n\n\ndef _cell_alignment(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Keep a table cell's `style` only as its text-align, and only if that is\n    one of the three a Markdown table writes; drop every other declaration.\"\"\"\n    if attribute != \"style\":\n        return value\n    if tag not in _TABLE_CELLS:\n        return None\n    for declaration in value.split(\";\"):\n        if match := _TEXT_ALIGN.fullmatch(declaration):\n            return f\"text-align:{match.group(1).lower()}\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None = None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"`text` as sanitized HTML, its `image:<name>` references resolved by\n    `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    return Markup(nh3.clean(_MARKDOWN.render(text or \"\", {\"image_src\": image_src}),\n                            attributes=_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                            attribute_filter=_cell_alignment,\n                            allowed_classes={\"div\": {TABLE_SCROLL}}))\n\n\ndef images_without_description(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The names in `text`'s `image:<name>` references that have no\n    description (alt text), in order, for the edit page to warn of: a screen\n    reader skips an image with an empty alt.\"\"\"\n    return [name for block in _MARKDOWN.parse(text or \"\") for token in block.children or []\n            if token.type == \"image\" and not token.content.strip()\n            and (name := _chart_image_name(token)) is not None]\n\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                (item_id, drafts_only),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n\ndef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n        return False\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n\n\ndef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n        return False\n    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\ndraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\npublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\nstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\nDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n\nA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\nreplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nA Report may also carry chart images (app.chart_images, ADR-004), stored apart\nfrom its PDF, so that changing one never touches the other. Adding or\nremoving an image follows the same lockdown again. Deleting a Report deletes\nits file and its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images, db, settings\nfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n_IMAGES = \"reports\"  # the chart_images kind\nLOCKED = \"Only the Director can change a published Report.\"\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update`, `remove_file`, `add_image`, and\n    `remove_image` apply the same rule in their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if pdf is None:\n        return None\n\n    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n\n    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n        if attach:\n            attach(conn, report_id)\n\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(report_id):\n        return False\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\napp/routes:\n__init__.py\n__pycache__\nadmin.py\nauth.py\ndata_bites.py\npublic.py\nreports.py\nsite_preview.py\nusers.py\n\ntemplates/admin:\n_chart_images.html\n_content_fields.html\n_site_preview.html\n_undescribed_images.html\ncontent.html\ndata_bite_edit.html\ndata_bites.html\nforbidden.html\nhome.html\nreport_edit.html\nreports.html\nusers.html\n\ntemplates/public:\n_lists.html\ndata_bite.html\ndata_bites.html\nhome.html\nlayout.html\nreport.html\nreports.html","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"1112f651-48c0-45be-99f5-5bfd5d620dea","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:16:19.398Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Markdown to safe HTML: the one pipeline every rendering of user-written\nMarkdown goes through: the public site, its export, and the Site preview.\n\nmarkdown-it-py renders (raw HTML in the Markdown is let through to it), then\nnh3 sanitizes, dropping <script>, event-handler attributes, javascript: URLs,\nand anything else not on its allowlist. The stored body stays raw; only this\nfunction's output is ever marked safe.\n\nTwo additions to nh3's allowlist, both for Markdown tables:\n  - `style` on a table cell, but only as exactly `text-align:left|right|center`,\n    so a column's alignment (`|---:|`) survives and nothing else does.\n  - the class TABLE_SCROLL on a <div>: each Markdown table is wrapped in one, so\n    a wide table can scroll sideways without restyling the <table> itself.\n\nAnd one addition to Markdown, for chart images (ADR-004): an image whose URL\nis `image:<name>` gets its URL from the `image_src` the caller passes, which\nknows the item's images and where the page being rendered finds them. A name\nit doesn't know, or no `image_src`, renders nothing. Any other image URL is\nleft to the sanitizer.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nTABLE_SCROLL = \"content-table-scroll\"\nIMAGE_REFERENCE = \"image:\"\n# A chart image's name -> its URL from the page being rendered; None if the\n# item has no image of that name.\nImageSrc = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n_MARKDOWN = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\")\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_open\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    f'<div class=\"{TABLE_SCROLL}\">\\n' + self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env)))\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_close\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env) + \"</div>\\n\"))\n\n\ndef _chart_image_name(token) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The name in an `image:<name>` image token; None for any other image.\"\"\"\n    src = token.attrGet(\"src\")\n    return src.removeprefix(IMAGE_REFERENCE) if str(src).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE) else None\n\n\ndef _render_image(self, tokens, idx, options, env):\n    name = _chart_image_name(tokens[idx])\n    if name is not None:\n        url = env[\"image_src\"](name) if env.get(\"image_src\") else None\n        if url is None:\n            return \"\"\n        tokens[idx].attrSet(\"src\", url)\n    return self.image(tokens, idx, options, env)\n\n\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"image\", _render_image)\n\n_TABLE_CELLS = (\"th\", \"td\")\n_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = {**nh3.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                       **{cell: nh3.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES.get(cell, set()) | {\"style\"}\n                          for cell in _TABLE_CELLS}}\n_TEXT_ALIGN = re.compile(r\"\\s*text-align\\s*:\\s*(left|right|center)\\s*\", re.I)\n\n\ndef _cell_alignment(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Keep a table cell's `style` only as its text-align, and only if that is\n    one of the three a Markdown table writes; drop every other declaration.\"\"\"\n    if attribute != \"style\":\n        return value\n    if tag not in _TABLE_CELLS:\n        return None\n    for declaration in value.split(\";\"):\n        if match := _TEXT_ALIGN.fullmatch(declaration):\n            return f\"text-align:{match.group(1).lower()}\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None = None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"`text` as sanitized HTML, its `image:<name>` references resolved by\n    `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    return Markup(nh3.clean(_MARKDOWN.render(text or \"\", {\"image_src\": image_src}),\n                            attributes=_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                            attribute_filter=_cell_alignment,\n                            allowed_classes={\"div\": {TABLE_SCROLL}}))\n\n\ndef images_without_description(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The names in `text`'s `image:<name>` references that have no\n    description (alt text), in order, for the edit page to warn of: a screen\n    reader skips an image with an empty alt.\"\"\"\n    return [name for block in _MARKDOWN.parse(text or \"\") for token in block.children or []\n            if token.type == \"image\" and not token.content.strip()\n            and (name := _chart_image_name(token)) is not None]\n\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                (item_id, drafts_only),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n\ndef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n        return False\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n\n\ndef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n        return False\n    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\ndraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\npublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\nstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\nDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n\nA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\nreplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nA Report may also carry chart images (app.chart_images, ADR-004), stored apart\nfrom its PDF, so that changing one never touches the other. Adding or\nremoving an image follows the same lockdown again. Deleting a Report deletes\nits file and its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images, db, settings\nfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n_IMAGES = \"reports\"  # the chart_images kind\nLOCKED = \"Only the Director can change a published Report.\"\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update`, `remove_file`, `add_image`, and\n    `remove_image` apply the same rule in their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if pdf is None:\n        return None\n\n    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n\n    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n        if attach:\n            attach(conn, report_id)\n\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(report_id):\n        return False\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, Any other page sends the browser to the published one.\"\"\"\n    if path == \"style.css\":\n        return stylesheet()\n    if path in images:\n        return chart_images.response(images[path])\n    if pdfs and path in pdfs:\n        return pdf_response(pdfs[path])\n    if not _SITE_PATH.fullmatch(path):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/\" + path, status_code=303)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"bc1bf0ef-c8e9-43f1-a24d-e8d9f4407fa9","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a045e549-5404-4369-8bec-6722840af3fd","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

templates/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  {%- block head %}{% endblock %}\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ css_path or path_for('stylesheet') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  {%- block banner %}{% endblock %}\n  <header><a class=\"header-home\" href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a>{% block nav %}{% endblock %}</header>\n  <main>\n    {%- if user is defined and user %}{% set message = confirmation() %}\n    {%- if message %}<p class=\"admin-confirmation\" role=\"status\">{{ message }}</p>{% endif %}{% endif %}\n    {%- block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n### templates/admin/_content_fields.html\n  <form class=\"admin-content-editing\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\"{% if file_label %} enctype=\"multipart/form-data\"{% endif %}>\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <div class=\"admin-content-fields\">\n    <p><label>Title <input type=\"text\" name=\"title\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required></label></p>\n    <p><label>Slug <input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" required\n      pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\" aria-describedby=\"slug-hint\"></label>\n      <small id=\"slug-hint\">Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.</small></p>\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br><textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"16\" cols=\"60\" required>{{ form.body }}</textarea></label></p>\n    {% if file_label %}\n    <p><label>{{ file_label }}\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf,.pdf\"></label></p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">{{ submit }}</button></p>\n    </div>\n    {#- After the save button, so Enter in a field still saves: the form's\n        first submit button is the one Enter presses. #}\n    {% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}\n  </form>\n### templates/admin/_site_preview.html\n{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n   form, the frame follows the title and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n   item as saved. #}\n  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n      {%- if preview_path %}\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\"]) data.append(name, form.elements[name].value);\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n### templates/admin/data_bite_edit.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_bites') }}\">All Data Bites</a></p>\n  <h1>Edit Data Bite</h1>\n  <p>{{ status_labels[bite.status] }}. Created {{ bite.created_at }} by {{ bite.author_name }}.\n     Last updated {{ bite.updated_at }}.</p>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% include \"admin/_undescribed_images.html\" %}\n  {% set action = \"/admin/data-bites/\" ~ bite.id %}\n  {% set submit = \"Save changes\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}\n{% endblock %}\n### templates/admin/report_edit.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_reports') }}\">All Reports</a></p>\n  <h1>{{ \"Edit Report\" if can_edit else report.title }}</h1>\n  <p>{{ status_labels[report.status] }}. Created {{ report.created_at }} by {{ report.author_name }}.\n     Last updated {{ report.updated_at }}.</p>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if can_edit %}{% include \"admin/_undescribed_images.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  <p>Attached file:\n    {% if report.file_name %}<a href=\"{{ path_for('download_file', report_id=report.id) }}\">{{ report.file_name }}</a>{% else %}none{% endif %}</p>\n  {% if can_edit %}\n  {% if report.file_name %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/reports/{{ report.id }}/file/delete\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Remove file</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% set action = \"/admin/reports/\" ~ report.id %}\n  {% set submit = \"Save changes\" %}\n  {% set file_label = (\"Replace\" if report.file_name else \"Attach\") ~ \" PDF (optional, up to \" ~ max_file_mb ~ \" MB)\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}\n  {% else %}\n  <p>Only the Director can edit, unpublish, or delete a published Report.</p>\n  <p>Slug: <code>{{ report.slug }}</code></p>\n  {% with preview_path = none %}{% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}{% endwith %}\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n### templates/admin/_undescribed_images.html\n{# The edit page's warning, which never blocks a save, for `image:` references\n   with no description. Needs `undescribed_images`. #}\n  {% if undescribed_images %}\n  <p class=\"content-image-warning\" role=\"status\">These images have no description, so a\n    screen reader will skip them:\n    {% for name in undescribed_images %}<code>{{ name }}</code>{{ \", \" if not loop.last }}{% endfor %}.\n    Write what the chart shows between the brackets, e.g. <code>![Fall enrollment by class](image:…)</code>.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n### templates/admin/_chart_images.html\n{# An item's chart images on its edit page. Needs `action` (the item's edit\n   URL, e.g. /admin/data-bites/3), `images`, `max_image_mb`, and `max_images`. #}\n  {% set images_path = action ~ \"/images\" %}\n  <section class=\"content-images\" aria-labelledby=\"content-images-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"content-images-heading\">Chart images</h2>\n    <p>To show an image, copy its line into the body, and replace <em>Description</em>\n      with what the chart shows, for readers who can't see it.</p>\n    {% if images %}\n    <ul class=\"content-images-list\">\n      {% for name in images %}\n      <li><code>![Description](image:{{ name }})</code>\n        <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ images_path }}/{{ name }}/delete\">\n          <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n          <button type=\"submit\" aria-label=\"Delete {{ name }}\">Delete</button>\n        </form></li>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </ul>\n    {% else %}\n    <p>None yet.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ images_path }}\" enctype=\"multipart/form-data\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n      <p><label>Upload an image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to {{ max_image_mb }} MB; {{ max_images }} at most)\n        <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" required\n               accept=\"image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp\"></label>\n        <small>An image with the same name as one above replaces it.</small></p>\n      <p><button type=\"submit\">Upload</button></p>\n    </form>\n  </section>\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.auth import csrf_token\nfrom app.flash import confirmation\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n    template never hard-codes a route's path. Admin pages only: the public\n    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\ntemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\ntemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public site\nat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, public, reports, users\n\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\nALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n\n\n@asynccontextmanager\nasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    db.init_db()\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n              file=sys.stderr)\n    yield\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n\n    app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, admin.refused_page)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    app.include_router(reports.router)\n\n    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n        if rest == \"\":\n            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"bd805921-5762-425f-8a9e-85f6ee1151b4","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:16:23.891Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"### templates/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html
