pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\" aria-describedby=\"slug-hint\"></label>\n      <small id=\"slug-hint\">Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.</small></p>\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br><textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"16\" cols=\"60\" required>{{ form.body }}</textarea></label></p>\n    {% if file_label %}\n    <p><label>{{ file_label }}\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf,.pdf\"></label></p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">{{ submit }}</button></p>\n    </div>\n    {#- After the save button, so Enter in a field still saves: the form's\n        first submit button is the one Enter presses. #}\n    {% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}\n  </form>\n### templates/admin/_site_preview.html\n{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n   form, the frame follows the title and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n   item as saved. #}\n  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n      {%- if preview_path %}\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\"]) data.append(name, form.elements[name].value);\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n### templates/admin/data_bite_edit.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_bites') }}\">All Data Bites</a></p>\n  <h1>Edit Data Bite</h1>\n  <p>{{ status_labels[bite.status] }}. Created {{ bite.created_at }} by {{ bite.author_name }}.\n     Last updated {{ bite.updated_at }}.</p>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% include \"admin/_undescribed_images.html\" %}\n  {% set action = \"/admin/data-bites/\" ~ bite.id %}\n  {% set submit = \"Save changes\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}\n{% endblock %}\n### templates/admin/report_edit.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_reports') }}\">All Reports</a></p>\n  <h1>{{ \"Edit Report\" if can_edit else report.title }}</h1>\n  <p>{{ status_labels[report.status] }}. Created {{ report.created_at }} by {{ report.author_name }}.\n     Last updated {{ report.updated_at }}.</p>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if can_edit %}{% include \"admin/_undescribed_images.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  <p>Attached file:\n    {% if report.file_name %}<a href=\"{{ path_for('download_file', report_id=report.id) }}\">{{ report.file_name }}</a>{% else %}none{% endif %}</p>\n  {% if can_edit %}\n  {% if report.file_name %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/reports/{{ report.id }}/file/delete\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Remove file</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% set action = \"/admin/reports/\" ~ report.id %}\n  {% set submit = \"Save changes\" %}\n  {% set file_label = (\"Replace\" if report.file_name else \"Attach\") ~ \" PDF (optional, up to \" ~ max_file_mb ~ \" MB)\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n  {% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}\n  {% else %}\n  <p>Only the Director can edit, unpublish, or delete a published Report.</p>\n  <p>Slug: <code>{{ report.slug }}</code></p>\n  {% with preview_path = none %}{% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}{% endwith %}\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n### templates/admin/_undescribed_images.html\n{# The edit page's warning, which never blocks a save, for `image:` references\n   with no description. Needs `undescribed_images`. #}\n  {% if undescribed_images %}\n  <p class=\"content-image-warning\" role=\"status\">These images have no description, so a\n    screen reader will skip them:\n    {% for name in undescribed_images %}<code>{{ name }}</code>{{ \", \" if not loop.last }}{% endfor %}.\n    Write what the chart shows between the brackets, e.g. <code>![Fall enrollment by class](image:…)</code>.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n### templates/admin/_chart_images.html\n{# An item's chart images on its edit page. Needs `action` (the item's edit\n   URL, e.g. /admin/data-bites/3), `images`, `max_image_mb`, and `max_images`. #}\n  {% set images_path = action ~ \"/images\" %}\n  <section class=\"content-images\" aria-labelledby=\"content-images-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"content-images-heading\">Chart images</h2>\n    <p>To show an image, copy its line into the body, and replace <em>Description</em>\n      with what the chart shows, for readers who can't see it.</p>\n    {% if images %}\n    <ul class=\"content-images-list\">\n      {% for name in images %}\n      <li><code>![Description](image:{{ name }})</code>\n        <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ images_path }}/{{ name }}/delete\">\n          <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n          <button type=\"submit\" aria-label=\"Delete {{ name }}\">Delete</button>\n        </form></li>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </ul>\n    {% else %}\n    <p>None yet.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ images_path }}\" enctype=\"multipart/form-data\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n      <p><label>Upload an image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to {{ max_image_mb }} MB; {{ max_images }} at most)\n        <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" required\n               accept=\"image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp\"></label>\n        <small>An image with the same name as one above replaces it.</small></p>\n      <p><button type=\"submit\">Upload</button></p>\n    </form>\n  </section>\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.auth import csrf_token\nfrom app.flash import confirmation\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n    template never hard-codes a route's path. Admin pages only: the public\n    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\ntemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\ntemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public site\nat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, public, reports, users\n\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\nALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n\n\n@asynccontextmanager\nasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    db.init_db()\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n              file=sys.stderr)\n    yield\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n\n    app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, admin.refused_page)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    app.include_router(reports.router)\n\n    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n        if rest == \"\":\n            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"bc1bf0ef-c8e9-43f1-a24d-e8d9f4407fa9","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4c4514e8-886e-4281-9637-7f4085b79e92","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"5d6ca731-b3e8-46c6-9b93-d3e8c727853a","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"53fa6da9-8f7a-4671-b98f-abfb45172e2f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017p9oiWDJxPe8v4YSKy487b","type":"tool_result","content":"def report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and\n    Reports' chart images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    return _data_bite_page(_as_if_published(form, saved))\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav)\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates one Director (admin) and one Analyst (editor), with passwords read from\n.env, never hard-coded, and demo content: a published and a draft Data Bite,\nand a published and a draft Report, so the public site and the admin console\nboth have something to show. Safe to re-run: an existing account, or an item\nwhose slug is already taken, is left alone.\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import data_bites, db, reports, settings, users\n\n# Keep in step with DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py.\nDEMO_ACCOUNTS = [\n    (\"admin@example.test\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\", \"admin\", \"Demo Director\"),\n    (\"editor@example.test\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\", \"editor\", \"Demo Analyst\"),\n]\n\n_DEMO_NOTE = \"*Demo content from `scripts/seed_demo.py`; the figures are made up.*\"\n\n# (module, title, slug, body, author's email, published?)\nDEMO_CONTENT = [\n    (data_bites, \"Fall enrollment snapshot\", \"fall-enrollment-snapshot\",\n     \"Headcount by class on the census date.\\n\\n\"\n     \"| Class | Students | Change |\\n|:--|--:|--:|\\n\"\n     \"| First-year | 480 | +2% |\\n| Sophomore | 455 | -1% |\\n\"\n     \"| Junior | 440 | 0% |\\n| Senior | 430 | +1% |\\n\\n\" + _DEMO_NOTE,\n     \"editor@example.test\", True),\n    (data_bites, \"Spring survey response rates\", \"spring-survey-response-rates\",\n     \"Response rates for the spring student survey, still being checked \"\n     \"before release.\\n\\n\" + _DEMO_NOTE,\n     \"editor@example.test\", experience | All students | February |\\n\"\n     \"| Faculty and staff | Employees | October |\\n\\n\" + _DEMO_NOTE,\n     \"admin@example.test\", True),\n    (reports, \"Common Data Set 2026-27\", \"common-data-set-2026-27\",\n     \"Draft of this year's Common Data Set, awaiting the Director's review.\\n\\n\"\n     + _DEMO_NOTE,\n     \"editor@example.test\", False),\n]\n\n\ndef _user_id(email: str) -> int:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()[0]\n\n\ndef seed_content() -> None:\n    for module, title, slug, body, author, published in DEMO_CONTENT:\n        if any(item[\"slug\"] == slug for item in module.list_all()):\n            print(f\"  exists   {slug}\")\n            continue\n        item_id = module.create(title, slug, body, _user_id(author))\n        if published:\n            module.set_status(item_id, \"published\")\n        print(f\"  created  {slug} ({'published' if published else 'draft'})\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = [var for _, var, _, _ in DEMO_ACCOUNTS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in name=name)\n        except users.DuplicateEmail:\n            print(f\"  exists   {email}\")\n        except users.UserError as exc:\n            print(f\"  {var}: {exc}\")\n            return 1\n        else:\n            print(f\"  created  {email} ({users.ROLE_LABELS[role]})\")\n    seed_content()\n    print(f\"Seeded {settings.DATABASE_PATH}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and\n    Reports' chart images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    return _data_bite_page(_as_if_published(form, saved))\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav)\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates one Director (admin) and one Analyst (editor), with passwords read from\n.env, never hard-coded, and demo content: a published and a draft Data Bite,\nand a published and a draft Report, so the public site and the admin console\nboth have something to show. \"Fall enrollment snapshot\", \"fall-enrollment-snapshot\",\n     \"Headcount by class on the census date.\\n\\n\"\n     \"| Class | Students | Change |\\n|:--|--:|--:|\\n\"\n     \"| First-year | 480 False),\n    (reports, \"Survey Calendar\", \"survey-calendar\",\n     \"Surveys the office runs, and when.\\n\\n\"\n     \"| Survey | Audience | Window |\\n|:--|:--|:--|\\n\"\n     \"| Student No\nlogin: everything here is published content only (app.public_site).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.public_site import Page\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _html(page: Page | None) -> HTMLResponse:\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return HTMLResponse(page.render())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\")\n@router.get(\"/index.html\")\ndef home():\n    return _html(public_site.home())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef stylesheet():\n    return Response(public_site.CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/\")\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/index.html\")\ndef data_bite_list():\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/{slug}.html\")\ndef data_bite(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.data_bite_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/\")\n@router.get(\"/reports/index.html\")\ndef report_list():\n    return _html(public_site.report_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/{slug}.html\")\ndef report(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.report(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/reports/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.report_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/files/{slug}.pdf\")\ndef report_file(slug: str):\n    found = public_site.report_file(slug)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return pdf_response(*found)\n\n\ndef pdf_response(path: Path, name: str | None = None) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A Report's stored file, served as a PDF and never sniffed as anything\n    else; downloaded as `name` if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\", filename=name,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\"\"\"The admin console. Every route on this router requires an active session:\nadd new admin routes here (or to a router built the same way) and they are\nprotected without further work.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom types import ModuleType\nfrom typing import Literal\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, Request\nfrom fastapi.exception_handlers import http_exception_handler\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports\nfrom app.auth import current_user\nfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n\n\nasync def refused_page(request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException):\n    \"\"\"A 403 (e.g. an Analyst on a Director-only page) as a page with a way\n    back, not FastAPI's JSON. Any other HTTP error is handled as FastAPI would.\"\"\"\n    if exc.status_code != 403:\n        return await http_exception_handler(request, exc)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/forbidden.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"home_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"admin_home\"),\n         \"reason\": exc.detail},\n        status_code=403,\n    )\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentType:\n    key: str        # e.g. \"data-bite\", as used in ids and query strings\n    noun: str       # e.g. \"Data Bite\"\n    plural: str     # e.g. \"Data Bites\"\n    module: ModuleType\n    list_path: str  # the type's own admin page, e.g. \"/admin/data-bites\"\n\n\nCONTENT_TYPES = (\n    ContentType(\"data-bite\", \"Data Bite\", \"Data Bites\", data_bites, \"/admin/data-bites\"),\n    ContentType(\"report\", \"Report\", \"Reports\", reports, \"/admin/reports\"),\n)\n# The content list's filters; \"\" (the form's \"All\") means no filter.\nTypeFilter = Literal[\"\", *(ctype.key for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES)]\nStatusFilter = Literal[\"\", *STATUS_LABELS]\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    counts = {ctype.key: ctype.module.count_by_status() for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES}\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/home.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/content\")\ndef content_list(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 content_type: TypeFilter = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\"),\n                 status: StatusFilter = \"\"):\n    \"\"\"Data Bites and Reports together, most recently updated first,\n    optionally narrowed to one type and/or one status.\"\"\"\n    items = [(ctype, item) for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES if content_type in (\"\", ctype.key)\n             for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)]\n    items.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[1][\"updated_at\"], reverse=True)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/content.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"All content\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"items\": items, \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"chosen\": {\"type\": content_type, \"status\": status}},\n    )\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role — it works as soon as your login route exists,\nso access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db, settings, users\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\"},\n}\n\n\ndef csrf_from(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_form(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef user_id(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"user-(\\d+)\"', user_row(director, email)).group(1)\n\n\ndef second_analyst(director: TestClient) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"A logged-in client for a second, named Analyst (not the seeded one).\"\"\"\n    account = {\"name\": \"Riley Intern\", \"email\": \"riley@example.test\",\n               \"password\": \"a-long-enough-password\", \"role\": \"editor\"}\n    assert post_form(director, \"/admin/users\", account).status_code == 303\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    c.post(\"/login\", data={**account, \"csrf_token\": token})\n    return c\n\n\ndef backdate(table: str, row_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Setup only: move a This ticket has more than 5 items, so here's the plan for your approval, with three decisions I need from you first.\n\n**Plan**\n\n1. **`app/markdown_form.py`**: a stdlib `html.parser` converter from sanitized Editor HTML to standard-form Markdown. It covers paragraphs, bold, italic, line breaks, lists, H2 and H3, quotes, tables (alignment kept), `https:`/`mailto:` links, and `image:<name>` images. Writer text gets escaped. Written test-first: every seed body and every T09/T10 fixture renders equivalent HTML after a no-change round trip, and hostile HTML never reaches a render.\n2. **`app/editor.py`**, the server side of the Editor:\n   - finds locked blocks from markdown-it top-level line maps\n   - swaps them for `locked-<n>` tokens and back\n   - renders the Editor HTML, with each locked block shown as its sanitized render and no raw bytes\n   - computes `item_base`\n   - turns a post into the body to save: untouched keeps stored bytes, edited is converted, and unknown, duplicated or forged tokens are refused\n\n   Written test-first. **Checkpoint: commit and show you the results.**\n3. **Routes and storage**: create, edit and preview for both types take `item_base`, `body_dirty` and `body_html`. A stale base is refused, with the check and the write in one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction, so nothing is written. Tests go through `TestClient`, including the title/slug conflict. The existing tests stay unchanged.\n4. **Editor script**: `templates/admin/editor.js`, vanilla JS served behind login.\n   - takes over the textarea\n   - toolbar\n   - paste cleanup for Word and Google Docs, with HTML tables kept\n   - pictures refused with a pointer to \"Insert image\"\n   - `beforeunload` warning\n   - feeds the Site preview\n   - minimal `admin-editor-*` CSS\n\n   **Checkpoint: screenshots at 390, 768 and 1440 px.**\n5. ADR-005, a link to it from the **Editor** entry in `CONTEXT.md`, then the full suite.\n6. `/code-review`, findings posted on #16, the browser check recorded, then commit `T13: …` ending `Closes #16`.\n\nOn the browser check: I can run Chrome through the extension, but I can't drive Safari. {"parentUuid":"2cb348a4-1f8d-477e-baa3-d931df9a32af","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"53fa6da9-8f7a-4671-b98f-abfb45172e2f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\"\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"0e23750d-2068-45e5-b36b-637d553b5927","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:18:59.186Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_016rBaNtSDX9EE4uTC2qs4kD","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"3085855a-1e00-449d-8b1f-352bc8e5a09f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaFGRxj1M22W6imEzAbD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Xc1b7xwn5FjXSfH8bqBEKb","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown_form.py","content":"\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe Editor posts HTML; the body is stored as Markdown. app.editor sanitizes\nthe posted HTML with nh3 first, and this module turns what is left into\nMarkdown, written one standard way, with stdlib `html.parser`. It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, links, and chart images inline. Any other element is let through as\nits text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it renders as the text\nit is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Inline: writer text, escaped.\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n\ndef _inline(node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n    \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are the emphases already open\n    around it, so a bold inside a bold is not marked twice.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(node, str):\n        return _escape(node)\n    if node.tag in _BOLD:\n        return _delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n    if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n        return _delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n    return \"\".join(_inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n\ndef _delimit(marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n    content = \"\".join(_inline(child, marks | {mark}) for child in node.children)\n    core = content.strip(\" \")\n    if mark in marks or not core:\n        return content\n    # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n    lead, trail = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))], content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n    return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n\n# Blocks.\n\ndef _paragraph(nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n    text = \"\".join(_inline(node) for node in nodes).strip(\" \")\n    return text or None\n\n\ndef _blocks(element: _Element) -> list[str]:\n    blocks: list[str] = []\n    for child in element.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"p\":\n            if (block := _paragraph(child.children)) is not None:\n                blocks.append(block)\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef to_markdown(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Sanitized Editor HTML as standard-form Markdown: blocks separated by\n    one blank line, ending in a newline; \"\" if nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    blocks = _blocks(_tree(html))\n    return \"\\n\\n\".join(blocks) + \"\\n\" if blocks else \"\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":856,"cache_read_input_tokens":128350,"output_tokens":2194,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":71},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":856,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2194,"cache_read_input_tokens":128350,"cache_creation_input_tokens":856,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":856},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01Xc1b7xwn5FjXSfH8bqBEKb":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown_form.py","content":"\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe Editor posts HTML; {"parentUuid":"a7b85662-039a-4cd0-98d6-6e372a0992c9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"53fa6da9-8f7a-4671-b98f-abfb45172e2f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Xc1b7xwn5FjXSfH8bqBEKb","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown_form.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"f1cf6312-6b87-47f2-9b35-2140c22d71b9","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:22:26.414Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown_form.py","content":"\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe Editor posts HTML; the body is stored as Markdown. app.editor sanitizes\nthe posted HTML with nh3 first, and this module turns what is left into\nMarkdown, written one standard way, with stdlib `html.parser`. It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, links, and chart images inline. Any other element is let through as\nits text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it renders as the text\nit is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Inline: writer text, escaped.\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n\ndef _inline(node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n    \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are the emphases already open\n    around it, so a bold inside a bold is not marked twice.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(node, str):\n        return _escape(node)\n    if node.tag in _BOLD:\n        return _delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n    if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n        return _delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n    return \"\".join(_inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n\ndef _delimit(marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n    content = \"\".join(_inline(child, marks | {mark}) for child in node.children)\n    core = content.strip(\" \")\n    if mark in marks or not core:\n        return content\n    # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n    lead, trail = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))], content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n    return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n\n# Blocks.\n\ndef _paragraph(nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n    text = \"\".join(_inline(node) for node in nodes).strip(\" \")\n    return text or None\n\n\ndef _blocks(element: _Element) -> list[str]:\n    blocks: list[str] = []\n    for child in element.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"p\":\n            if (block := _paragraph(child.children)) is not None:\n                blocks.append(block)\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef to_markdown(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Sanitized Editor HTML as standard-form Markdown: blocks separated by\n    one blank line, ending in a newline; \"\" if nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    blocks = _blocks(_tree(html))\n    return \"\\n\\n\".join(blocks) + \"\\n\" if blocks else \"\"\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a7b85662-039a-4cd0-98d6-6e372a0992c9","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"a3f9bd1f-2b36-4bed-8983-76f732a04ae5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaFXvZM4TbZsY4m19WEr","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2551,"cache_read_input_tokens":149997,"output_tokens":5738,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":53},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2551,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":5738,"cache_read_input_tokens":149997,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2551,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2551},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"752ab53c-1465-4841-b7e7-11c2ce337ad5","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CfaFXvCmhi7XFaQNtJkwQ","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"7e6e57f6-d6ec-4e4a-9329-b4f700f3d921","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:25:38.436Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"7e6e57f6-d6ec-4e4a-9329-b4f700f3d921","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaFXvZM4TbZsY4m19WEr","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GvGzAWEuVg8U3Qn5n2DKzT","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown_form.py","content":"\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe Editor posts HTML; the body is stored as Markdown. app.editor sanitizes\nthe posted HTML with nh3 first, and this module turns what is left into\nMarkdown, written one standard way, with stdlib `html.parser`. It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, `https:`/`mailto:` links, and chart images inline. Any other element\nis let through as its text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it\nrenders as the text it is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\n# An <img>'s src -> the name of the item's chart image it shows; None for\n# any other picture, which is dropped.\nImageName = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n# At the start of a line, the syntax that _ESCAPED leaves alone: a list\n# marker, a setext underline, or a numbered list's \"1.\" or \"1)\".\n_LINE_START = re.compile(r\"^(?:([-+=])|(\\d+)([.)]))\")\n# In a link's destination: what would end it early, and what Markdown would\n# otherwise read as an escape or an entity.\n_DESTINATION_ENCODED = re.compile(r\"[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]\")\n_DESTINATION_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\()&])\")\n# The only links the Editor keeps (spec #14, \"Links\"); a site link is T14's.\n_LINK_SCHEMES = (\"https:\", \"mailto:\")\n\n# A line break, in inline Markdown before it is split into lines. Writer text\n# never holds one: _escape turns every newline into a space.\n_BREAK = \"\\n\"\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n# The title is the page's only H1, so a pasted H1 becomes a Section; the\n# Editor has no level below a Subsection.\n_HEADING_LEVELS = {\"h1\": 2, \"h2\": 2, \"h3\": 3, \"h4\": 3, \"h5\": 3, \"h6\": 3}\n_LISTS = {\"ul\", \"ol\"}\n_TABLE_SECTIONS = {\"thead\", \"tbody\", \"tfoot\"}\n_CELLS = {\"th\", \"td\"}\n# Elements that hold blocks, not inline text. Any other element is inline;\n# one the Editor doesn't write (a <div> or <section> from a paste) is a\n# wrapper, and only what is in it is kept.\n_BLOCK_TAGS = {\"p\", \"blockquote\", \"table\", \"hr\", \"pre\", \"li\", \"tr\", \"caption\",\n               *_LISTS, *_HEADING_LEVELS, *_TABLE_SECTIONS, *_CELLS,\n               \"div\", \"section\", \"article\", \"header\", \"footer\", \"main\", \"aside\", \"nav\",\n               \"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"address\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"dl\", \"dt\", \"dd\",\n               \"center\"}\n_ALIGNMENTS = {\"text-align:left\": \":--\", \"text-align:right\": \"--:\",\n               \"text-align:center\": \":-:\"}\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\ndef _escape_line_start(line: str) -> str:\n    return _LINE_START.sub(lambda m: f\"\\\\{m[1]}\" if m[1] else f\"{m[2]}\\\\{m[3]}\", line)\n\n\ndef _destination(url: str) -> str:\n    url = _DESTINATION_ENCODED.sub(lambda m: f\"%{ord(m[0]):02X}\", url)\n    return _DESTINATION_ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", url)\n\n\ndef _is_block(node: _Element | str) -> bool:\n    return isinstance(node, _Element) and node.tag in _BLOCK_TAGS\n\n\ndef _indent(text: str, first: str, rest: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text` with `first` before its first line and `rest` before each\n    other non-empty line.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split(\"\\n\")\n    return \"\\n\".join([first + lines[0], *(rest + line if line else \"\" for line in lines[1:])])\n\n\ndef _start(ol: _Element) -> int:\n    start = ol.attrs.get(\"start\", \"1\").strip()\n    return int(start) if start.isdigit() and len(start) <= 9 else 1\n\n\ndef _items(listing: _Element) -> list[list[_Element | str]]:\n    \"\"\"A list's items, each as its children. Inline.\n\n    def inline(self, node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n        \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are what is already open\n        around it (\"bold\", \"italic\", \"link\"), so none is written twice.\"\"\"\n        if isinstance(node, str):\n            return _escape(node)\n        if node.tag == \"br\":\n            return _BREAK\n        if node.tag == \"img\":\n            return self.image(node)\n        if node.tag in _BOLD:\n            return self.delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n        if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n            return self.delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n        if node.tag == \"a\":\n            return self.link(node, marks)\n        return self.content(node, marks)\n\n    def content(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        return \"\".join(self.inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n    def delimit(self, marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n        content = self.content(node, marks | {mark})\n        core = content.strip(\" \")\n        if mark in marks or not core:\n            return content\n        # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n        lead = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))]\n        trail = content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n        return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n    def link(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        text = self.content(node, marks | {\"link\"})\n        href = node.attrs.get(\"href\", \"\").strip()\n        if \"link\" in marks or not text.strip() or not href.lower().startswith(_LINK_SCHEMES):\n            return text\n        return f\"[{text}]({_destination(href)})\"\n\n    def image(self, node: _Element) -> str:\n        name = self.image_name(node.attrs.get(\"src\", \"\")) if self.image_name else None\n        if name is None:\n            return \"\"\n        return f\"![{_escape(node.attrs.get('alt', ''))}]({_destination('image:' + name)})\"\n\n    def lines(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Inline nodes as lines of Markdown, split at line breaks, with no\n        empty line at either end.\"\"\"\n        lines = [_escape_line_start(line.strip(\" \"))\n                 for line in \"\".join(self.inline(node) for node in nodes).split(_BREAK)]\n        while lines and not lines[-1]:\n            lines.pop()\n        while lines and not lines[0]:\n            lines.pop(0)\n        return lines\n\n    # Blocks.\n\n    def blocks(self, element: _Element) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"An element's children as Markdown blocks, in order. A run of\n        inline children between blocks is a paragraph.\"\"\"\n        blocks: list[str | None] = []\n        run: list[_Element | str] = []\n        # The marker of the list just written, if the last block is a list:\n        # a list straight after another of the same kind needs the other\n        # marker, or Markdown joins the two.\n        previous_marker: str | None = None\n        for child in [*element.children, None]:\n            if child is not None and not _is_block(child):\n                run.append(child)\n                continue\n            if run and (paragraph := self.paragraph(run)) is not None:\n                blocks.append(paragraph)\n                previous_marker = None\n            run = []\n            if child is None:\n                break\n            if child.tag in _LISTS:\n                ordered = child.tag == \"ol\"\n                marker = (\")\" if previous_marker == \".\" else \".\") if ordered else (\n                    \"*\" if previous_marker == \"-\" else \"-\")\n                if (block := self.list(child, marker)) is not None:\n                    blocks.append(block)\n                    previous_marker = marker\n                continue\n            previous_marker = None\n            if child.tag == \"p\":\n                blocks.append(self.paragraph(child.children))\n            elif child.tag in _HEADING_LEVELS:\n                blocks.append(self.heading(_HEADING_LEVELS[child.tag], child.children))\n            elif child.tag == \"blockquote\":\n                blocks.append(self.quote(child))\n            elif child.tag == \"table\":\n                blocks.append(self.table(child))\n            else:\n                blocks.extend(self.blocks(child))\n        return [block for block in blocks if block is not None]\n\n    def paragraph(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A backslash at the end of a line is a line break.\n        return \"\\\\\\n\".join(self.lines(nodes)) or None\n\n    def heading(self, level: int, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        #
