It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, `https:`/`mailto:` links, and chart images inline. Any other element\nis let through as its text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it\nrenders as the text it is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\n# An <img>'s src -> the name of the item's chart image it shows; None for\n# any other picture, which is dropped.\nImageName = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n# At the start of a line, the syntax that _ESCAPED leaves alone: a list\n# marker, a setext underline, or a numbered list's \"1.\" or \"1)\".\n_LINE_START = re.compile(r\"^(?:([-+=])|(\\d+)([.)]))\")\n# In a link's destination: what would end it early, and what Markdown would\n# otherwise read as an escape or an entity.\n_DESTINATION_ENCODED = re.compile(r\"[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]\")\n_DESTINATION_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\()&])\")\n# The only links the Editor keeps (spec #14, \"Links\"); a site link is T14's.\n_LINK_SCHEMES = (\"https:\", \"mailto:\")\n\n# A line break, in inline Markdown before it is split into lines. Writer text\n# never holds one: _escape turns every newline into a space.\n_BREAK = \"\\n\"\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n# The title is the page's only H1, so a pasted H1 becomes a Section; the\n# Editor has no level below a Subsection.\n_HEADING_LEVELS = {\"h1\": 2, \"h2\": 2, \"h3\": 3, \"h4\": 3, \"h5\": 3, \"h6\": 3}\n_LISTS = {\"ul\", \"ol\"}\n_TABLE_SECTIONS = {\"thead\", \"tbody\", \"tfoot\"}\n_CELLS = {\"th\", \"td\"}\n# Elements that hold blocks, not inline text. Any other element is inline;\n# one the Editor doesn't write (a <div> or <section> from a paste) is a\n# wrapper, and only what is in it is kept.\n_BLOCK_TAGS = {\"p\", \"blockquote\", \"table\", \"hr\", \"pre\", \"li\", \"tr\", \"caption\",\n               *_LISTS, *_HEADING_LEVELS, *_TABLE_SECTIONS, *_CELLS,\n               \"div\", \"section\", \"article\", \"header\", \"footer\", \"main\", \"aside\", \"nav\",\n               \"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"address\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"dl\", \"dt\", \"dd\",\n               \"center\"}\n_ALIGNMENTS = {\"text-align:left\": \":--\", \"text-align:right\": \"--:\",\n               \"text-align:center\": \":-:\"}\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\ndef _escape_line_start(line: str) -> str:\n    return _LINE_START.sub(lambda m: f\"\\\\{m[1]}\" if m[1] else f\"{m[2]}\\\\{m[3]}\", line)\n\n\ndef _destination(url: str) -> str:\n    url = _DESTINATION_ENCODED.sub(lambda m: f\"%{ord(m[0]):02X}\", url)\n    return _DESTINATION_ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", url)\n\n\ndef _is_block(node: _Element | str) -> bool:\n    return isinstance(node, _Element) and node.tag in _BLOCK_TAGS\n\n\ndef _indent(text: str, first: str, rest: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text` with `first` before its first line and `rest` before each\n    other non-empty line.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split(\"\\n\")\n    return \"\\n\".join([first + lines[0], *(rest + line if line else \"\" for line in lines[1:])])\n\n\ndef _start(ol: _Element) -> int:\n    start = ol.attrs.get(\"start\", \"1\").strip()\n    return int(start) if start.isdigit() and len(start) <= 9 else 1\n\n\ndef _items(listing: _Element) -> list[list[_Element | str]]:\n    \"\"\"A list's items, each as its children. A list put straight inside a\n    list, not in an item (as some browsers indent), belongs to the item\n    before it.\"\"\"\n    items: list[list[_Element | str]] = []\n    for child in listing.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"li\":\n            items.append(list(child.children))\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) or child.strip():\n            if not items:\n                items.append([])\n            items[-1].append(child)\n    return items\n\n\ndef _rows(table: _Element) -> list[_Element]:\n    \"\"\"A table's rows, in order, from its sections or straight inside it.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    for child in table.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"tr\":\n            rows.append(child)\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag in _TABLE_SECTIONS:\n            rows.extend(row for row in child.children\n                        if isinstance(row, _Element) and row.tag == \"tr\")\n    return rows\n\n\ndef _without_breaks(node: _Element | str) -> _Element | str:\n    \"\"\"A table cell's content with each line break as a space: a Markdown\n    table row is one line.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(node, str):\n        return node\n    if node.tag == \"br\":\n        return \" \"\n    return _Element(node.tag, node.attrs, [_without_breaks(child) for child in node.children])\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Converter:\n    image_name: ImageName | None\n\n    # Inline.\n\n    def inline(self, node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n        \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are what is already open\n        around it (\"bold\", \"italic\", \"link\"), so none is written twice.\"\"\"\n        if isinstance(node, str):\n            return _escape(node)\n        if node.tag == \"br\":\n            return _BREAK\n        if node.tag == \"img\":\n            return self.image(node)\n        if node.tag in _BOLD:\n            return self.delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n        if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n            return self.delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n        if node.tag == \"a\":\n            return self.link(node, marks)\n        return self.content(node, marks)\n\n    def content(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        return \"\".join(self.inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n    def delimit(self, marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n        content = self.content(node, marks | {mark})\n        core = content.strip(\" \")\n        if mark in marks or not core:\n            return content\n        # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n        lead = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))]\n        trail = content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n        return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n    def link(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        text = self.content(node, marks | {\"link\"})\n        href = node.attrs.get(\"href\", \"\").strip()\n        if \"link\" in marks or not text.strip() or not href.lower().startswith(_LINK_SCHEMES):\n            return text\n        return f\"[{text}]({_destination(href)})\"\n\n    def image(self, node: _Element) -> str:\n        name = self.image_name(node.attrs.get(\"src\", \"\")) if self.image_name else None\n        if name is None:\n            return \"\"\n        return f\"![{_escape(node.attrs.get('alt', ''))}]({_destination('image:' + name)})\"\n\n    def lines(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Inline nodes as lines of Markdown, split at line breaks, with no\n        empty line at either end.\"\"\"\n        lines = [_escape_line_start(line.strip(\" \"))\n                 for line in \"\".join(self.inline(node) for node in nodes).split(_BREAK)]\n        while lines and not lines[-1]:\n            lines.pop()\n        while lines and not lines[0]:\n            lines.pop(0)\n        return lines\n\n    # Blocks.\n\n    def blocks(self, element: _Element) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"An element's children as Markdown blocks, in order. A run of\n        inline children between blocks is a paragraph.\"\"\"\n        blocks: list[str | None] = []\n        run: list[_Element | str] = []\n        # The marker of the list just written, if the last block is a list:\n        # a list straight after another of the same kind needs the other\n        # marker, or Markdown joins the two.\n        previous_marker: str | None = None\n        for child in [*element.children, None]:\n            if child is not None and not _is_block(child):\n                run.append(child)\n                continue\n            if run and (paragraph := self.paragraph(run)) is not None:\n                blocks.append(paragraph)\n                previous_marker = None\n            run = []\n            if child is None:\n                break\n            if child.tag in _LISTS:\n                ordered = child.tag == \"ol\"\n                marker = (\")\" if previous_marker == \".\" else \".\") if ordered else (\n                    \"*\" if previous_marker == \"-\" else \"-\")\n                if (block := self.list(child, marker)) is not None:\n                    blocks.append(block)\n                    previous_marker = marker\n                continue\n            previous_marker = None\n            if child.tag == \"p\":\n                blocks.append(self.paragraph(child.children))\n            elif child.tag in _HEADING_LEVELS:\n                blocks.append(self.heading(_HEADING_LEVELS[child.tag], child.children))\n            elif child.tag == \"blockquote\":\n                blocks.append(self.quote(child))\n            elif child.tag == \"table\":\n                blocks.append(self.table(child))\n            else:\n                blocks.extend(self.blocks(child))\n        return [block for block in blocks if block is not None]\n\n    def paragraph(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A backslash at the end of a line is a line break.\n        return \"\\\\\\n\".join(self.lines(nodes)) or None\n\n    def heading(self, level: int, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A heading is one line: a line break in it is a space.\n        text = \" \".join(self.lines(nodes))\n        return f\"{'#' * level} {text}\" if text else None\n\n    def list(self, listing: _Element, marker: str) -> str | None:\n        items = _items(listing)\n        if not items:\n            return None\n        # It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, `https:`/`mailto:` links, and chart images inline. Any other element\nis let through as its text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it\nrenders as the text it is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\n# An <img>'s src -> the name of the item's chart image it shows; None for\n# any other picture, which is dropped.\nImageName = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n# At the start of a line, the syntax that _ESCAPED leaves alone: a list\n# marker, a setext underline, or a numbered list's \"1.\" or \"1)\".\n_LINE_START = re.compile(r\"^(?:([-+=])|(\\d+)([.)]))\")\n# In a link's destination: what would end it early, and what Markdown would\n# otherwise read as an escape or an entity.\n_DESTINATION_ENCODED = re.compile(r\"[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]\")\n_DESTINATION_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\()&])\")\n# The only links the Editor keeps (spec #14, \"Links\"); a site link is T14's.\n_LINK_SCHEMES = (\"https:\", \"mailto:\")\n\n# A line break, in inline Markdown before it is split into lines. Writer text\n# never holds one: _escape turns every newline into a space.\n_BREAK = \"\\n\"\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n# The title is the page's only H1, so a pasted H1 becomes a Section; the\n# Editor has no level below a Subsection.\n_HEADING_LEVELS = {\"h1\": 2, \"h2\": 2, \"h3\": 3, \"h4\": 3, \"h5\": 3, \"h6\": 3}\n_LISTS = {\"ul\", \"ol\"}\n_TABLE_SECTIONS = {\"thead\", \"tbody\", \"tfoot\"}\n_CELLS = {\"th\", \"td\"}\n# Elements that hold blocks, not inline text. Any other element is inline;\n# one the Editor doesn't write (a <div> or <section> from a paste) is a\n# wrapper, and only what is in it is kept.\n_BLOCK_TAGS = {\"p\", \"blockquote\", \"table\", \"hr\", \"pre\", \"li\", \"tr\", \"caption\",\n               *_LISTS, *_HEADING_LEVELS, *_TABLE_SECTIONS, *_CELLS,\n               \"div\", \"section\", \"article\", \"header\", \"footer\", \"main\", \"aside\", \"nav\",\n               \"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"address\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"dl\", \"dt\", \"dd\",\n               \"center\"}\n_ALIGNMENTS = {\"text-align:left\": \":--\", \"text-align:right\": \"--:\",\n               \"text-align:center\": \":-:\"}\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\ndef _escape_line_start(line: str) -> str:\n    return _LINE_START.sub(lambda m: f\"\\\\{m[1]}\" if m[1] else f\"{m[2]}\\\\{m[3]}\", line)\n\n\ndef _destination(url: str) -> str:\n    url = _DESTINATION_ENCODED.sub(lambda m: f\"%{ord(m[0]):02X}\", url)\n    return _DESTINATION_ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", url)\n\n\ndef _is_block(node: _Element | str) -> bool:\n    return isinstance(node, _Element) and node.tag in _BLOCK_TAGS\n\n\ndef _indent(text: str, first: str, rest: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text` with `first` before its first line and `rest` before each\n    other non-empty line.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split(\"\\n\")\n    return \"\\n\".join([first + lines[0], *(rest + line if line else \"\" for line in lines[1:])])\n\n\ndef _start(ol: _Element) -> int:\n    start = ol.attrs.get(\"start\", \"1\").strip()\n    return int(start) if start.isdigit() and len(start) <= 9 else 1\n\n\ndef _items(listing: _Element) -> list[list[_Element | str]]:\n    \"\"\"A list's items, each as its children. A list put straight inside a\n    list, not in an item (as some browsers indent), belongs to the item\n    before it.\"\"\"\n    items: list[list[_Element | str]] = []\n    for child in listing.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"li\":\n            items.append(list(child.children))\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) or child.strip():\n            if not items:\n                items.append([])\n            items[-1].append(child)\n    return items\n\n\ndef _rows(table: _Element) -> list[_Element]:\n    \"\"\"A table's rows, in order, from its sections or straight inside it.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    for child in table.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"tr\":\n            rows.append(child)\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag in _TABLE_SECTIONS:\n            rows.extend(row for row in child.children\n                        if isinstance(row, _Element) and row.tag == \"tr\")\n    return rows\n\n\ndef _without_breaks(node: _Element | str) -> _Element | str:\n    \"\"\"A table cell's content with each line break as a space: a Markdown\n    table row is one line.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(node, str):\n        return node\n    if node.tag == \"br\":\n        return \" \"\n    return _Element(node.tag, node.attrs, [_without_breaks(child) for child in node.children])\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Converter:\n    image_name: ImageName | None\n\n    # Inline.\n\n    def inline(self, node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n        \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are what is already open\n        around it (\"bold\", \"italic\", \"link\"), so none is written twice.\"\"\"\n        if isinstance(node, str):\n            return _escape(node)\n        if node.tag == \"br\":\n            return _BREAK\n        if node.tag == \"img\":\n            return self.image(node)\n        if node.tag in _BOLD:\n            return self.delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n        if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n            return self.delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n        if node.tag == \"a\":\n            return self.link(node, marks)\n        return self.content(node, marks)\n\n    def content(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        return \"\".join(self.inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n    def delimit(self, marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n        content = self.content(node, marks | {mark})\n        core = content.strip(\" \")\n        if mark in marks or not core:\n            return content\n        # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n        lead = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))]\n        trail = content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n        return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n    def link(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        text = self.content(node, marks | {\"link\"})\n        href = node.attrs.get(\"href\", \"\").strip()\n        if \"link\" in marks or not text.strip() or not href.lower().startswith(_LINK_SCHEMES):\n            return text\n        return f\"[{text}]({_destination(href)})\"\n\n    def image(self, node: _Element) -> str:\n        name = self.image_name(node.attrs.get(\"src\", \"\")) if self.image_name else None\n        if name is None:\n            return \"\"\n        return f\"![{_escape(node.attrs.get('alt', ''))}]({_destination('image:' + name)})\"\n\n    def lines(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Inline nodes as lines of Markdown, split at line breaks, with no\n        empty line at either end.\"\"\"\n        lines = [_escape_line_start(line.strip(\" \"))\n                 for line in \"\".join(self.inline(node) for node in nodes).split(_BREAK)]\n        while lines and not lines[-1]:\n            lines.pop()\n        while lines and not lines[0]:\n            lines.pop(0)\n        return lines\n\n    # Blocks.\n\n    def blocks(self, element: _Element) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"An element's children as Markdown blocks, in order. A run of\n        inline children between blocks is a paragraph.\"\"\"\n        blocks: list[str | None] = []\n        run: list[_Element | str] = []\n        # The marker of the list just written, if the last block is a list:\n        # a list straight after another of the same kind needs the other\n        # marker, or Markdown joins the two.\n        previous_marker: str | None = None\n        for child in [*element.children, None]:\n            if child is not None and not _is_block(child):\n                run.append(child)\n                continue\n            if run and (paragraph := self.paragraph(run)) is not None:\n                blocks.append(paragraph)\n                previous_marker = None\n            run = []\n            if child is None:\n                break\n            if child.tag in _LISTS:\n                ordered = child.tag == \"ol\"\n                marker = (\")\" if previous_marker == \".\" else \".\") if ordered else (\n                    \"*\" if previous_marker == \"-\" else \"-\")\n                if (block := self.list(child, marker)) is not None:\n                    blocks.append(block)\n                    previous_marker = marker\n                continue\n            previous_marker = None\n            if child.tag == \"p\":\n                blocks.append(self.paragraph(child.children))\n            elif child.tag in _HEADING_LEVELS:\n                blocks.append(self.heading(_HEADING_LEVELS[child.tag], child.children))\n            elif child.tag == \"blockquote\":\n                blocks.append(self.quote(child))\n            elif child.tag == \"table\":\n                blocks.append(self.table(child))\n            else:\n                blocks.extend(self.blocks(child))\n        return [block for block in blocks if block is not None]\n\n    def paragraph(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A backslash at the end of a line is a line break.\n        return \"\\\\\\n\".join(self.lines(nodes)) or None\n\n    def heading(self, level: int, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A heading is one line: a line break in it is a space.\n        text = \" \".join(self.lines(nodes))\n        return f\"{'#' * level} {text}\" if text else None\n\n    def list(self, listing: _Element, marker: str) -> str | None:\n        items = _items(listing)\n        if not items:\n            return None\n        # A list whose items hold paragraphs is loose: blank lines between\n        # its items and their blocks, which Markdown renders as <p>s again.\n        loose = any(isinstance(node, _Element) and node.tag == \"p\"\n                    for item in items for node in item)\n        separator = \"\\n\\n\" if loose else \"\\n\"\n        number = _start(listing)\n        written = []\n        for item in items:\n            prefix = f\"{number}{marker} \" if marker in \".)\" else f\"{marker} \"\n            number += 1\n            content = separator.join(self.blocks(_Element(\"li\", children=item)))\n            written.append(_indent(content, prefix, \" \" * len(prefix)) if content\n                           else prefix.rstrip())\n        return separator.join(written)\n\n    def quote(self, quote: _Element) -> str | None:\n        blocks = self.blocks(quote)\n        if not blocks:\n            return None\n        return \"\\n\".join(f\"> {line}\" if line else \">\"\n                         for line in \"\\n\\n\".join(blocks).split(\"\\n\"))\n\n    def cell(self, cell: _Element) -> str:\n        blocks = self.blocks(_without_breaks(cell))\n        return \" \".join(line.strip() for block in blocks for line in block.split(\"\\n\")\n                        if line.strip())\n\n    def table(self, table: _Element) -> str | None:\n        \"\"\"A table as a Markdown table. Its first row is the header, and each\n        column is aligned as its header cell is.\"\"\"\n        rows = [[cell for cell in row.children if isinstance(cell, _Element)\n                 and cell.tag in _CELLS] for row in _rows(table)]\n        width = max(map(len, rows), default=0)\n        if not width:\n            return None\n        text = [[self.cell(cell) for cell in row] + [\"\"] * (width - len(row)) for row in rows]\n        header = rows[0] + [None] * (width - len(rows[0]))\n        alignment = [_ALIGNMENTS.get(cell.attrs.get(\"style\", \"\") if cell else \"\", \"---\")\n                     for cell in header]\n        return \"\\n\".join(f\"| {' | '.join(row)} |\" for row in [text[0], alignment, *text[1:]])\n\n\ndef to_markdown(html: str, image_name: ImageName | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Sanitized Editor HTML as standard-form Markdown: blocks separated by\n    one blank line, ending in a newline; \"\" if nothing is left. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\n\nfrom app.markdown_form import LOCKED_TOKEN\nfrom app.rendering import IMAGE_REFERENCE, parse\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_LINK_SCHEMES = (\"https:\", \"mailto:\")\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"href\")).lower().startswith(_LINK_SCHEMES)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None)\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] == [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"] \\\n            and LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content):\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks, depth = [], 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}\\n\")\n        locked.append(_NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])).removesuffix(\"\\n\"))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9f68b8b1-6cc4-4a43-a855-8750dafdde58","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"30425dcb-900e-4b25-924a-6eb6dc806aca","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaGBEEFnKMk1Lj48wtr1","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've finished plan steps 1–2 and committed them as `26b2db6`. The full suite passes: 511 tests, all the existing ones unchanged.\n\n**Converter** (`app/markdown_form.py`, 57 tests): turns the Editor's HTML into Markdown written one standard way.\n- It handles paragraphs, line breaks, H2/H3, bulleted and numbered lists (nested, loose, numbered from any start), block quotes, tables (alignment kept, first row as the header), `https:`/`mailto:` links and `image:<name>` chart images.\n- Any other link keeps its text but loses the link.\n- 28 pieces of text that look like Markdown syntax render exactly as typed, checked by rendering them for real.\n\n**Editor server side** (`app/editor.py`, 117 tests):\n- **Locked blocks:** each kind the spec lists (code, raw HTML, H1, H4, rule, inline code, non-`https` links, titled links, hot-linked images, a code block inside a list) locks its whole top-level block.\n- **Untouched is byte-for-byte:** holds for every seed body and every T09/T10 fixture, with plain and Windows line endings, whatever HTML is posted.\n- **No-change round trip:** renders the same HTML for all of them, and saving the result a second time changes nothing.\n- **Editing:** changing one paragraph changes only that paragraph.\n- **Editor view of locked blocks:** shows their rendered HTML and never their source.\n- **Saving around locked blocks:** their bytes survive edits around them, and a removed one drops only that block. Unknown, duplicated or forged tokens are refused.\n- **Plain-textarea fallback:** it holds the body with tokens in place of locked blocks, as you chose. Saving it untouched keeps the stored body, and an edit gets its locked blocks back.\n- **Hostile HTML:** script, event handlers, `style`, `javascript:` links, links starting with `/`, iframes, SVG and forms never reach a render.\n\nTwo things came up along the way:\n- **Seed note:** I removed its code span, as agreed. A database seeded before today still has the old note, which will show as a locked paragraph.\n- **Type checking:** the project has no type checker, so I ran mypy through `uvx` without adding it as a dependency. My new code is clean. Two errors in `app/content.py` were already there, and I left them.\n\nNext are steps 3 and 4: the routes (`item_base`, `body_dirty`, refusing a stale save including the title/slug conflict) and the Editor script. I'll finish with screenshots at 390, 768 and 1440 px. Shall I go ahead?"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":673,"cache_read_input_tokens":198556,"output_tokens":909,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":29},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":673,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":909,"cache_read_input_tokens":198556,"cache_creation_input_tokens":673,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":673},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"ea593ac1-761b-43ab-a5f0-2e3ee992c2ec","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfaGBDjjoP2so5nZ34qKS","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"0b747c4e-3fd5-4fd5-a573-efa72dab57e7","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:34:11.762Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"7f995efb-6ed0-4418-9367-04a7af4195f9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaGW4Uup5vJxsnEet3iM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013VN61qLHoFxGfdNvftLojo","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t13_editor_routes.py","content":"\"\"\"T13: the Editor on the Data Bite and Report edit and create pages (issue\n#16): the base version, untouched bodies, locked blocks, and the Markdown\nfallback, through the routes.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports\nfrom app.content import item_base\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import site_preview_page\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor import HOSTILE, LOCKED_BODY\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, data_bites, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, reports, id=\"report\")]\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\ndef stored(module, item_id: str):\n    return module.get(int(item_id))\n\n\ndef edit_page(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> str:\n    response = c.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    return response.text\n\n\ndef field(page: str, name: str) -> str:\n    [value] = re.findall(rf'<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"{name}\" value=\"([^\"]*)\">', page)\n    return unescape(value)\n\n\ndef textarea(page: str) -> str:\n    [value] = re.findall(r'<textarea name=\"body\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>', page, re.S)\n    return unescape(value)\n\n\ndef editor_content(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Editor's HTML, which its script loads into the editable area.\"\"\"\n    [value] = re.findall(r'<template class=\"admin-editor-content\">(.*?)</template>', page, re.S)\n    return value\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str, page: str, **form):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form as the Editor does, from `page` as opened: its base\n    version, and the Editor's HTML untouched unless `form` says otherwise.\"\"\"\n    data = {\"title\": re.search(r'name=\"title\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1],\n            \"slug\": re.search(r'name=\"slug\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1],\n            \"body\": textarea(page), \"item_base\": field(page, \"item_base\"),\n            \"body_html\": editor_content(page), \"body_dirty\": \"0\",\n            \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(page), **form}\n    return c.post(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef director(client_as):\n    return client_as(\"admin\")\n\n\n# The base version.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_edit_page_carries_the_base_version(director, kind, item, create, module):\n    item_id = create(director)\n    row = stored(module, item_id)\n    page = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    assert field(page, \"item_base\") == item_base(row[\"title\"], row[\"slug\"], row[\"body\"])\n    assert editor_content(page).strip().startswith(\"<p>\")\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"change\", [{\"title\": \"Retitled by tab B\"}, {\"slug\": \"moved-by-tab-b\"},\n                                    {\"body\": \"Rewritten by tab B.\"}])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_save_from_a_stale_page_is_refused_and_writes_nothing(\n        director, kind, item, create, module, change):\n    item_id = create(director)\n    tab_a = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    tab_b = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, tab_b, **change).status_code == 303\n    after_b = dict(stored(module, item_id))\n\n    # Tab A saves its untouched body, and a new title.\n    response = save(director, kind, item_id, tab_a, title=\"Tab A's title\")\n    assert response.status_code == 409\n    assert STALE in response.text\n    assert dict(stored(module, item_id)) == after_b\n    # Tab A's unsaved title is still on screen, and saving again is refused.\n    assert 'value=\"Tab A&#39;s title\"' in response.text\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, response.text).status_code == 409\n\n\n# Untouched and edited bodies.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_untouched_body_is_kept_byte_for_byte_whatever_html_is_posted(\n        director, kind, item, create, module):\n    body = \"Soft\\r\\nwrapped   text *with* __odd__ spacing.\\r\\n\\r\\n* a list\\r\\n\"\n    item_id = create(director, body=body)\n    page = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, page, title=\"New title\",\n                body_html=\"<p>Something else entirely</p>\").status_code == 303\n    row = stored(module, item_id)\n    assert row[\"body\"] == body and row[\"title\"] == \"New title\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_an_edited_body_is_saved_in_standard_form(director, kind, item, create, module):\n    item_id = create(director, body=\"Old  *body*\\r\\n\\r\\n* a list\\r\\n\")\n    page = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    html = editor_content(page).replace(\"Old\", \"New\")\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module, item_id)[\"body\"] == \"New *body*\\n\\n- a list\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_the_editor_needs_the_base_version(director):\n    item_id = create_bite(director)\n    page = edit_page(director, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    assert save(director, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, item_base=\"\",\n                body_html=\"<p>x</p>\", body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 400\n    assert stored(data_bites, item_id)[\"body\"] == BITE[\"body\"]\n\n\n# Locked blocks.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_locked_blocks_source_never_reaches_the_browser(director, kind, item, create, module):\n    item_id = create(director, body=LOCKED_BODY)\n    page = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    for source in (\"```\", \"`inline code`\", \"<script>alert\", \"&lt;script&gt;alert('x')&lt;/script&gt;\\n```\"):\n        assert source not in page, source\n    assert textarea(page).splitlines()[2] == \"locked-0\"\n    assert 'data-locked=\"locked-0\"' in editor_content(page)\n    assert \"This part can&#39;t be edited here.\" in editor_content(page)\n    # The Site preview shows the whole body, rendered.\n    assert \"<code>inline code</code>\" in content_body(site_preview_page(page))\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_locked_blocks_survive_an_edit_around_them(director, kind, item, create, module):\n    item_id = create(director, body=LOCKED_BODY)\n    page = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    html = re.sub(r'(data-locked=\"locked-\\d+\">).*?</div></div>', r\"\\1</div>\",\n                  editor_content(page), flags=re.S).replace(\"Middle\", \"Edited\")\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, page, body_html=html, body_dirty=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    body = stored(module, item_id)[\"body\"]\n    assert \"```\\r\\n<script>alert('x')</script>\\r\\n```\" in body\n    assert \"Outro with `inline code`, kept.\" in body and \"Edited paragraph.\" in body\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"html\", ['<div data-locked=\"locked-5\"></div>',\n                                  '<div data-locked=\"locked-0\"></div>' * 2,\n                                  '<div data-locked=\"locked-0\"><p>forged</p></div>'])\ndef test_an_unknown_duplicated_or_forged_token_refuses_the_save(director, html):\n    item_id = create_bite(director, body=LOCKED_BODY)\n    page = edit_page(director, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    response = save(director, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, title=\"Changed\",\n                    body_html=\"<p>Intro.</p>\" + html, body_dirty=\"1\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert dict(stored(data_bites, item_id))[\"title\"] == BITE[\"title\"]\n    assert stored(data_bites, item_id)[\"body\"] == LOCKED_BODY\n\n\n# The Markdown fallback: no script, so no body_html.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_fallback_textarea_saves_markdown_and_keeps_locked_blocks(\n        director, kind, item, create, module):\n    item_id = create(director, body=LOCKED_BODY)\n    page = edit_page(director, kind, item_id)\n    body = textarea(page).replace(\"Middle\", \"Edited\")\n    response = post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\",\n                         {\"title\": \"T\", \"slug\": \"s\", \"body\": body,\n                          \"item_base\": field(page, \"item_base\")})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert stored(module, item_id)[\"body\"] == LOCKED_BODY.replace(\"Middle\", \"Edited\")\n\n\n# Creating, previewing, and hostile {"parentUuid":"396b984d-305f-4cb3-a5da-f036a0750010","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaGdQfnct9F15fBNoCU3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01APzBKkN57cXTnWkJLmS6Dv","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\np='app/editor.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''from dataclasses import dataclass\n''','''from collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n''')\ns=s.replace('''from app.content import ContentError\n''','''from app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\n''')\ns+='''\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        body = posted.body\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`. StaleItem if the item has changed since; ContentError if the\n    Editor posted without a base version, or as saved_body. Old forms and\n    scripts that post no base, and no Editor HTML, are not checked.\"\"\"\n    if base and base != item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]):\n        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n    if posted.body_html is not None and not base:\n        raise ContentError(NEEDS_BASE)\n    return saved_body(posted, item[\"body\"], image_name)\n'''\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\nuv run python -c \"import app.editor\"","description":"Add edit-form helpers to the editor module"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6212,"cache_read_input_tokens":213994,"output_tokens":1615,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":323},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6212,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1615,"cache_read_input_tokens":213994,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6212,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6212},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01APzBKkN57cXTnWkJLmS6Dv":{"command":"cd /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && python3 - <<'EOF'\np='app/editor.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''from dataclasses import dataclass\n''','''from collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n''')\ns=s.replace('''from app.content import ContentError\n''','''from app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\n''')\ns+='''\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. here is for the writer's sake, never the site's safety.\n(() => {\n  \"use strict\";\n\n  const LINK = /^(https:\\/\\/|mailto:)/i;\n  const LINK_REFUSED = \"Links must start with https:// or = \"The pasted text had pictures, which were left out. \" +\n    'Upload a picture under \"Chart images\", then use \"Insert image\".';\n  const LOCKED = \"[data-locked]\";\n  // The Editor's blocks, = 0;\n  for (const wrapper of document.querySelectorAll(\".admin-editor\")) takeOver(wrapper);\n\n  function takeOver(wrapper) {\n    const form = wrapper.closest(\"form\");\n    const textarea = bodyDirty.value = wrapper.dataset.bodyDirty === \"1\" ? \"1\" : \"0\";\n    // Whether leaving the page would lose anything: the body, or any field.\n    let unsaved = bodyDirty.value === \"1\";\n    let leaving = false;\n\n    const ui = element(\"div\", {class: \"admin-editor-ui\"});\n    ui.innerHTML = `\n      <p class=\"admin-editor-label\" id=\"${id}-label\">Body</p>\n      <div aria-pressed=\"false\">Subsection</button>\n        <button type=\"button\" data-action=\"quote\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Quote</button>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"admin-editor-link\" hidden>\n        <label>Link address <input type=\"text\" inputmode=\"url\" autocomplete=\"off\"\n          placeholder=\"https://\" aria-describedby=\"${id}-link-hint\"></label>\n        <button type=\"button\" admin-editor-area\" id=\"${id}\" contenteditable=\"true\"\n        role=\"textbox\" aria-multiline=\"true\" aria-labelledby=\"${id}-label\"></div>`;\n    const area = (event.target.closest(\"button\")) event.preventDefault();\n    });\n    toolbar.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n      const button = event.target.closest(\"button[data-action]\");\n      if document.execCommand(name, false, value);\n    }\n\n    function toggleHeading(tag) {\n      const block = closest(\"h2, h3\");\n      command(\"formatBlock\", block && block.tagName.toLowerCase() === tag ? \"<p>\" : `<${tag}>`);\n    }\n\n    function toggleQuote() {\n      const quote = closest(\"blockquote\");\n      if (!quote) return command(\"formatBlock\", \"<blockquote>\");\n      // Its blocks go back into the body, each a paragraph at least.\n      const blocks = [];\n      let run = null;\n      for (const node of [...quote.childNodes]) {\n        if (node.nodeType === run.append(node);\n        }\n      }\n      quote.replaceWith(...blocks);\n      changedHere();\n    }\n\n    function showState() {\n      if (!area.contains(document.getSelection().anchorNode)) linkRange = null;\n\n    function openLink() {\n      linkRange = currentRange();\n      const link = closest(\"a\");\n      linkInput.value = link ? link.getAttribute(\"href\") : \"\";\n      linkPanel.querySelector(\"[data-link=remove]\").hidden = !link;\n      linkPanel.hidden = false;\n      linkInput.focus();\n    }\n\n    function closeLink() {\n      linkPanel.hidden = true;\n      restoreRange();\n    }\n\n    function restoreRange() {\n      area.focus();\n      if (linkRange) {\n        const selection = document.getSelection();\n        selection.removeAllRanges();\n        selection.addRange(linkRange);\n      }\n    }\n\n    function addLink() {\n      const href = linkInput.value.trim();\n      if (!LINK.test(href) || !validUrl(href)) {\n        message(LINK_REFUSED);\n        linkInput.focus();\n        return;\n      }\n      linkPanel.hidden = true;\n      message(\"\");\n      restoreRange();\n      const link = closest(\"a\");\n      if (link) {\n        link.setAttribute(\"href\", href);\n        changedHere();\n      } else if (!linkRange || linkRange.collapsed) {\n        // No text chosen: the address is the link's text.\n        command(\"insertHTML\", `<a href=\"${escapeHtml(href)}\">${escapeHtml(href)}</a>`);\n      } else {\n        command(\"createLink\", href);\n      }\n    }\n\n    function removeLink() {\n      linkPanel.hidden = true;\n      restoreRange();\n      const link = closest(\"a\");\n      if (!link) return;\n      const range = document.createRange();\n      range.selectNodeContents(link);\n      document.getSelection().removeAllRanges();\n      document.getSelection().addRange(range);\n      command(\"unlink\");\n    }\n\n    linkPanel.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n      const action = event.target.closest(\"button\")?.dataset.link;\n      if (action === \"add\") addLink();\n      else if (action === \"remove\") removeLink();\n      else if (action === \"cancel\") closeLink();\n    });\n    linkInput.addEventListener(\"keydown\", (event) => {\n      // Enter adds the link rather than submitting the form.\n      if (event.key === \"Enter\") {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        addLink();\n      } else if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        closeLink();\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Paste and drop.\n\n    area.addEventListener(\"paste\", (event) => {\n      const data = event.clipboardData;\n      if (!data) return;\n      event.preventDefault();\n      const html = data.getData(\"text/html\");\n      const text = data.getData(\"text/plain\");\n      if (html) {\n        const cleaned = cleanPasted(html);\n        if (cleaned.droppedPicture) message(PICTURE_DROPPED);\n        if (cleaned.html) command(\"insertHTML\", cleaned.html);\n      } else if (text) {\n        command(\"insertHTML\", textAsHtml(text));\n      } else if ([...data.items].some((item) => item.kind === \"file\")) {\n        message(PICTURE_REFUSED);\n      }\n    });\n    area.addEventListener(\"dragover\", (event) => {\n      if (hasFiles(event.dataTransfer)) event.preventDefault();\n    });\n    area.addEventListener(\"drop\", (event) => {\n      if (hasFiles(event.dataTransfer)) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        message(PICTURE_REFUSED);\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Text dragged in from elsewhere keeps only what the Editor supports.\n    function tidyDropped() {\n      for (const img of area.querySelectorAll(\"img\")) {\n        if (!ownImages.has(img)) {\n          img.remove();\n          message(PICTURE_DROPPED);\n        }\n      }\n      for (const node of area.querySelectorAll(\"[style], span, font\")) {\n        if (node.closest(LOCKED)) continue;\n        if (node.tagName === \"SPAN\" || node.tagName === \"FONT\") node.replaceWith(...node.childNodes);\n        else node.removeAttribute(\"style\");\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Locked blocks: shown, not changedHere();\n      });\n      (block.querySelector(\".admin-editor-locked-note\") || block).append(\" \", remove);\n    }\n\n    // Helpers.\n\n    function ensureParagraph() {\n      if tell the form, as the\n      // browser does for its own, so the Site preview follows it too.\n      area.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent(\"input\", {bubbles: true}));\n    }\n\n    function sync() {\n function posted() {\n      const copy = area.cloneNode(true);\n      for (const block of copy.querySelectorAll(LOCKED)) {\n        let top = block;\n        while (top.parentNode !== copy) top = top.parentNode;\n        if (top !== block) top.after(block);\n        block.replaceChildren();\n        block.removeAttribute(\"contenteditable\");\n      }\n      return copy.innerHTML;\n    }\n\n    function closest(selector) {\n      const node = document.getSelection().anchorNode;\n      const start = node && (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE ? node : node.parentElement);\n      const found = start && start.closest(selector);\n      return found && area.contains(found) && found !== area ? found : null;\n    }\n\n    function currentRange() {\n      const selection = {"parentUuid":"ad338c46-da2c-49c0-a832-56e337253feb","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"5cb50f6f-f71e-403d-a475-7d941b50e18e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"# Claude in Chrome browser automation\n\nYou have access to browser automation tools (mcp__claude-in-chrome__*) for interacting with web pages in Chrome. Follow these guidelines for effective browser automation.\n\n## Loading deferred tools\n\nIf the mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load every tool you expect to need in ONE ToolSearch call — the select query accepts a comma-separated list — never one call per tool. Start with the core set:\n\nToolSearch with query \"select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp\"\n\nAdd task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting.\n\n## GIF recording\n\nWhen performing multi-step browser interactions that the user may want to review or share, use mcp__claude-in-chrome__gif_creator to record them.\n\nYou must ALWAYS:\n* Capture extra frames before and after taking actions to ensure smooth playback\n* Name the file meaningfully to help the user identify it later (e.g., \"login_process.gif\")\n\n## Console log debugging\n\nYou can use mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages to read console output. Console output may be verbose. If you are looking for specific log entries, use the 'pattern' parameter with a regex-compatible pattern. This filters results efficiently and avoids overwhelming output. For example, use pattern: \"[MyApp]\" to filter for application-specific logs rather than reading all console output.\n\n## Alerts and dialogs\n\nIMPORTANT: Do not trigger JavaScript alerts, confirms, prompts, or browser modal dialogs through your actions. These browser dialogs block all further browser events and will prevent the extension from receiving any subsequent commands. Instead, when possible, use console.log for debugging and then use the mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages tool to read those log messages. If a page has dialog-triggering elements:\n1. Avoid clicking buttons or links that may trigger alerts (e.g., \"Delete\" buttons with confirmation dialogs)\n2. If you must interact with such elements, warn the user first that this may interrupt the session\n3. Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__javascript_tool to check for and dismiss any existing dialogs before proceeding\n\nIf you accidentally trigger a dialog and lose responsiveness, inform the user they need to manually dismiss it in the browser.\n\n## Avoid rabbit holes and loops\n\nWhen using browser automation tools, stay focused on the specific task. If you encounter any of the following, stop and ask the user for guidance:\n- Unexpected complexity or tangential browser exploration\n- Browser tool calls failing or returning errors after 2-3 attempts\n- No response from the browser extension\n- Page elements not responding to clicks or input\n- Pages not loading or timing out\n- Unable to complete the browser task despite multiple approaches\n\nExplain what you attempted, what went wrong, and ask how the user would like to proceed. Do not keep retrying the same failing browser action or explore unrelated pages without checking in first.\n\n## Tab context and session startup\n\nIMPORTANT: At the start of each browser automation session, call mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp first to get information about the user's current browser tabs. Use this context to understand what the user might want to work with before creating new tabs.\n\nNever reuse tab IDs from a previous/other session. Follow these guidelines:\n1. Only reuse an existing tab if the user explicitly asks to work with it\n2. Otherwise, create a new tab with mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp\n3. If a tool returns an error indicating the tab doesn't exist or is invalid, call tabs_context_mcp to get fresh tab IDs\n4. Paste keeps only supported\nformatting (Google Docs styles, Word lists, spreadsheet tables); a\npasted or dropped picture is refused with a message. The link panel\ntakes only https: and mailto:. {"parentUuid":"4284b8f3-9fa6-49df-9bd9-70e8b700e0a7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaHoADXKoJvNgaN9NvvD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01515Qs3q8QypW4VryfsSU1U","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md","content":"# ADR-005: The Editor stores Markdown\n\n**Status:** accepted (spec #14, ticket #16)\n**Date:** 2026-09-30\n\n## Context\n\nThe office's writers are IR staff and interns, not web developers, and every\nbody was typed as Markdown in a textarea. Spec #14 replaces the textarea with\nthe **Editor**, a visual editor. That raises two questions: what the body is\nstored as, and what the Editor is built with.\n\nStoring the Editor's HTML was considered and rejected. Every body already\nstored, the sanitizer, `cms publish`, and every test assume Markdown; HTML\nfrom a browser's `contenteditable` differs by browser and would change\nwhenever the same body is opened and saved; and the site would have to trust\nstored HTML rather than render it. A Markdown or rich-text editor library was\nrejected too: `pyproject.toml` is fixed, and ADR-002 has no build step.\n\n## Decision\n\n**The body stays Markdown.** The Editor is `contenteditable` and a toolbar in\nplain JavaScript (`static/editor.js`), with no dependency.\n\n- On load, the server renders the body to the Editor's HTML with the site's\n  own pipeline (`app.editor`). On save, the Editor posts its HTML, and the\n  server sanitizes it with nh3 and turns it into Markdown with stdlib\n  `html.parser` (`app.markdown_form`), always in one **standard form**.\n- **Untouched is byte-for-byte.** The Editor posts `body_dirty=0` until the\n  writer's first change, and then the server keeps the stored body and ignores\n  the posted HTML. The client can only choose \"keep what is stored\", so the\n  flag grants nothing. Opening and saving an item never rewrites its body.\n- **The base version.** The edit form carries `item_base`, a SHA-256 of the\n  stored title, slug, and body. A save from a form opened on an older version\n  is refused whole (\"This item changed since you opened it.\"), checked again in\n  the same transaction as the write. Nothing is merged.\n- **Locked blocks.** A top-level block the Editor can't represent (a code\n  block, raw HTML, an H1 or H4, a rule, an inline code span, a link that isn't\n  `https:` or `mailto:`, ...) is cut out and replaced by a `locked-<n>` token.\n  The Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML, read-only, with a Remove\n  button; its Markdown never reaches the browser. On save each token is\n  replaced by that block's bytes from the **stored** body, never from the post.\n  An unknown, repeated, or filled-in token refuses the save; a missing one was\n  removed.\n- **The fallback.** If the script doesn't run, the textarea still posts\n  Markdown: the body with each locked block as its token line, restored the\n  same way on save.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- The sanitizer, `cms publish`, the public site, and all stored content are\n  unchanged. A body can still be written as Markdown through the fallback.\n- A body the Editor has changed is rewritten in the standard form: the same\n  rendered HTML, but not the writer's original spacing or list markers. Only\n  a changed body is rewritten.\n- The Editor can only offer what Markdown can hold: no underline, fonts,\n  colours, or alignment.\n- Content the Editor can't represent stays safe but read-only in it, until\n  someone removes it or edits it through the fallback.\n- A link reference definition (`[x]: https://...`) is not a block, so it is\n  not kept when the Editor rewrites a body; a link that used it is written\n  inline instead. A locked block that used one loses its link.\n- `app.markdown_form` is the one place that decides what the standard form is.\n  T15 (tables) and T16 (Charts) extend it rather than adding their own.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1189,"cache_read_input_tokens":319062,"output_tokens":1775,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1189,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1775,"cache_read_input_tokens":319062,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1189,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1189},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01515Qs3q8QypW4VryfsSU1U":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md","content":"# ADR-005: The Editor stores Markdown\n\n**Status:** accepted (spec #14, ticket #16)\n**Date:** 2026-09-30\n\n## Context\n\nThe office's writers are IR staff and interns, not web developers, and every\nbody was typed as Markdown in a textarea. A Markdown or rich-text editor library was\nrejected too: `pyproject.toml` is fixed, and ADR-002 has no build step.\n\n## Decision\n\n**The body stays Markdown.** The Editor is `contenteditable` and a toolbar in\nplain JavaScript (`static/editor.js`), with no dependency.\n\n- On load, the server renders the body to the Editor's HTML with the site's\n  own pipeline (`app.editor`). A save from a form opened on an older version\n  is refused whole (\"This item changed since you opened it.\"), checked again in\n  the same transaction as the write. {"parentUuid":"68f6fa83-caee-4356-80d8-823026347424","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"28247e96-0075-4c3d-95c3-a03b076f199b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01515Qs3q8QypW4VryfsSU1U","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"7946f2b3-86e1-4abb-9a5b-210dfb5a22a4","timestamp":"2026-09-30T20:55:34.648Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md","content":"# ADR-005: The Editor stores Markdown\n\n**Status:** accepted (spec #14, ticket #16)\n**Date:** 2026-09-30\n\n## Context\n\nThe office's writers are IR staff and interns, not web developers, and every\nbody was typed as Markdown in a textarea. Spec #14 replaces the textarea with\nthe **Editor**, a visual editor. That raises two questions: what the body is\nstored as, and what the Editor is built with.\n\nStoring the Editor's HTML was considered and rejected. Every body already\nstored, the sanitizer, `cms publish`, and every test assume Markdown; HTML\nfrom a browser's `contenteditable` differs by browser and would change\nwhenever the same body is opened and saved; and the site would have to trust\nstored HTML rather than render it. A Markdown or rich-text editor library was\nrejected too: `pyproject.toml` is fixed, and ADR-002 has no build step.\n\n## Decision\n\n**The body stays Markdown.** The Editor is `contenteditable` and a toolbar in\nplain JavaScript (`static/editor.js`), with no dependency.\n\n- On load, the server renders the body to the Editor's HTML with the site's\n  own pipeline (`app.editor`). On save, the Editor posts its HTML, and the\n  server sanitizes it with nh3 and turns it into Markdown with stdlib\n  `html.parser` (`app.markdown_form`), always in one **standard form**.\n- **Untouched is byte-for-byte.** The Editor posts `body_dirty=0` until the\n  writer's first change, and then the server keeps the stored body and ignores\n  the posted HTML. The client can only choose \"keep what is stored\", so the\n  flag grants nothing. Opening and saving an item never rewrites its body.\n- **The base version.** The edit form carries `item_base`, a SHA-256 of the\n  stored title, slug, and body. A save from a form opened on an older version\n  is refused whole (\"This item changed since you opened it.\"), checked again in\n  the same transaction as the write. Nothing is merged.\n- **Locked blocks.** A top-level block the Editor can't represent (a code\n  block, raw HTML, an H1 or H4, a rule, an inline code span, a link that isn't\n  `https:` or `mailto:`, ...) is cut out and replaced by a `locked-<n>` token.\n  The Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML, read-only, with a Remove\n  button; its Markdown never reaches the browser. On save each token is\n  replaced by that block's bytes from the **stored** body, never from the post.\n  An unknown, repeated, or filled-in token refuses the save; a missing one was\n  removed.\n- **The fallback.** If the script doesn't run, the textarea still posts\n  Markdown: the body with each locked block as its token line, restored the\n  same way on save.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- The sanitizer, `cms publish`, the public site, and all stored content are\n  unchanged. A body can still be written as Markdown through the fallback.\n- A body the Editor has changed is rewritten in the standard form: the same\n  rendered HTML, but not the writer's original spacing or list markers. Only\n  a changed body is rewritten.\n- The Editor can only offer what Markdown can hold: no underline, fonts,\n  colours, or alignment.\n- Content the Editor can't represent stays safe but read-only in it, until\n  someone removes it or edits it through the fallback.\n- A link reference definition (`[x]: https://...`) is not a block, so it is\n  not kept when the Editor rewrites a body; a link that used it is written\n  inline instead. A locked block that used one loses its link.\n- `app.markdown_form` is the one place that decides what the standard form is.\n  T15 (tables) and T16 (Charts) extend it rather than adding their own.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"68f6fa83-caee-4356-80d8-823026347424","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"92814826-9c7e-4d79-92fd-82d4264d2156","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
